assistant|moncayo_must_try_activity: Hiking is recommended as the must-try activity in the Natural Park of Moncayo
assistant|moncayo_recommended_trail: GR-90 recommended as best hiking trail: circular, ~36 km, takes 2-3 days, passes small towns, summit of Moncayo and Fuenfría waterfall highlights
assistant|moncayo_best_hiking_season: Spring and autumn are the best seasons for hiking in Moncayo; summer is hot and crowded, winter has snow
assistant|moncayo_accommodation_options: Rural cottages, camping sites, guesthouses/hotels in Tarazona, Veruela, and Borja, and hostels are available near the park
assistant|moncayo_activities: Park activities include hiking, wildlife watching, camping, skiing in winter, mountain biking, cultural visits (Monastery of Veruela, Castle of Trasmoz), picnicking, and rock climbing
assistant|cottage_booking_platforms: Booking.com, Airbnb, and TripAdvisor recommended for finding rural cottages in Moncayo
assistant|moncayo_wildlife_species: Moncayo park wildlife includes eagles, vultures, deer, and wild boars, suitable for bird watching
assistant|moncayo_summer_hiking_precauti: For summer hiking in Moncayo, avoid the hottest hours of the day and drink plenty of water to stay hydrated
assistant|moncayo_booking_advice: It is best to book Moncayo accommodation in advance, especially during peak tourist season, to secure location and price
